frontmatter.title: Flexibility vs. Specialization: Striking the Right Balance in Software Engineering
frontmatter.subheading: Mastering the Art of Being a Generalist and Specialist in the Tech Industry
frontmatter.excerpt: In a field that values specialization, can flexibility find its place? This blog explores how to balance these seemingly contrasting skill sets for career success in software engineering.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
